mapper.select: SELECT p.* , u.nickname AS created_by_nickname FROM places p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.created_by WHERE p.place_id = #{placeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO places ( collection_id , name , address , lat , lng , category , tags , memo , visited_yn , rating , opening_hours , phone , website , created_by ) SELECT #{toCollectionId} , name , address , lat , lng , category , tags , memo , 'N' , rating , opening_hours , phone , website , #{userId} FROM places WHERE collection_id = #{fromCollectionId}
mapper.select: SELECT photo_id , place_id , file_path , original_name , created_at FROM place_photos WHERE place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY photo_id
